status: engineering default rubric; not validated success probabilities
limited: Eligible observations but sparse/confounded/transfer hypothesis; assumptions and target mismatch explicit. No automatic conversion confidence.
moderate: Multiple comparable independent own units, sufficient measured coverage, relevant context and stable directional pattern; review rubric and disclose confounders.
strong: Reserve for independently replicated relevant evidence with stable evaluated support. Do not assign just from n or model self-confidence.
threshold_selection: Version numeric sufficiency/cooldown thresholds with data/impact rationale before evaluations; prototype eight posts is a fixture gate only.
